title: Strength Conditioning (To be paired with MMA)
author: Antonio  M.
desc: For context I am not a coach or anything but I’ve been lifting for a while and I’m now transitioning into combat sports. This is made to retain and improve strength while doing high intensity, high volume, MMA training. Im not the strongest guy ever but I’d say I’m above intermediate level so this is an attempt to compromise both of my favorite hobbies. Im sure there’s room for improvement so just see this as a template you to create something better for your goals. Ok bye bye
